name: bt_adapter_enable

ownership.argument: Astrolink binds this as F_ADAPTER_ENABLE to bring the controller up before registering its GAP callbacks. Sibling wrappers of the same adapter command helper are 0xC3AF4CC (command 0x18), 0xC3AF4F4 (command 0x1B, already recorded as bt_adapter_get_state) and 0xC3AF524 (command 0x1E with one argument).

provenance.source: Issues adapter command 0x17 through 0xC3AC47C(adapter, reply, 0x17) and returns the status byte at reply+12, or 7 for a NULL adapter. The btstack init path 0xC70189C calls it directly after btstack_sdk_init and reports its failure with the log call 0xC708A98('bt_adapter_enable', status), which names the function from the inside.
